title: Sizing the policy wiki crawl

steps.title: Source limit
steps.body: 300 requests per minute per token. Pace below quota, about 240 per minute, to leave room for retries.

steps.title: List calls
steps.body: 38,400 pages at 100 per page is 384 calls: under two minutes at 240 per minute.

steps.title: Detail calls
steps.body: If read groups need one call per page, add 38,400 calls: about 160 minutes per full run.

steps.title: Glean side
steps.body: /indexdocuments accepts 600 documents per minute; /indexdocument accepts 10 requests per second. Confirm the current bulk limit before you commit a window.

steps.title: Deployment ceiling
steps.body: 8,000 requests per minute across all IP addresses and 100 requests per second from one IP apply across the deployment.

steps.title: Result
steps.body: A nightly full run fits in about three hours. Hourly incrementals fit easily.

footnote: Case numbers are fictional. The pacing rule and the Glean limits are sourced.
